嗨。: 在人际交往中，第一印象决定着将要发生的事情内容的百分之五十以上。
When people meet, first impressions determine more than 50 percent of whatever happens next.

嗨。: 如果我们应该少听多说话, 那么我们应该得到两个嘴巴一只耳朵才是。
If we were supposed to talk more than listen, we would have been given two mouths and one ear.

嗨。: 汤姆试过还回泳衣来换成更大一号的，但是员工告诉他那是不被允许的。
Tom tried to return the swimsuit for a larger size, but the clerk told him that wasn't allowed.

嗨。: 在十九世纪三十年代的大萧条时期，许多富人在股市崩盘中失去了一切。
During the Depression in the 1930's, many wealthy people lost everything in the stock market crash.

嗨。: 假如你在老师讲课的时候再集中一点去听讲的话，你应该就能弄明白了。
If you'd listen a little more carefully to what the teacher says, you'd probably be able to understand.

嗨。: 虽然我被公司解雇了，但是我还有点存款，所以目前不用担心生计问题。
I got fired from the company, but since I have a little money saved up, for the time being, I won't have trouble with living expenses.

嗨。: 这个工人本来应该在中午十二点到达, 但他被交通堵塞困住了几个小时。
The handyman was supposed to arrive at twelve noon, but got stuck in a traffic jam for a few hours.

嗨。: 刚开始的时候你可能不会喜欢这个啤酒。这是需要多次品尝去习惯它的口味。
You might not like this beer at first. It's an acquired taste.

嗨。: 即使是现在，我偶尔还是想见到你。不是今天的你，而是我记忆中曾经的你。
Even now, I occasionally think I'd like to see you. Not the you that you are today, but the you I remember from the past.

嗨。: 每天早上吃一只活青蛙, 那么你一天中其他的时间就不会发生什么更糟糕的事了。
Eat a live frog every morning, and nothing worse will happen to you the rest of the day.

嗨。: 汤姆不喜欢使用”有色人种“这个术语，因为他认为，根据这种说法白种人没有颜色。
Tom doesn't like to use the term "a person of color" because he thinks it implies that white people have no color.

嗨。: 我建立了部落格。我会尽量努力，不想成为那种只在初期短暂活跃发文，然后就放弃的人。
I started a new blog. I'll do my best not to be one of those people who blogs a lot right at the start and then quits blogging.
